comment: Closure-keyed certification (RC-3, overhaul ruling D.3). Every gate declares its input_closure: the ordered repo path prefixes (trailing slash) or exact tracked paths whose committed bytes the gate reads. A gate verdict is keyed by closure_sha = sha256 over the sorted (blob sha, path) pairs of every tracked file inside (input_closure + implicit_closure) minus exclude, computed from the git tree, never from a producer field. A commit that leaves a gate's closure byte-identical does not need that gate re-run: the existing green verdict for that closure_sha stays consumable. The census test asserts every tracked source path under census_roots sits inside at least one gate's closure, so nothing escapes certification by living outside every closure. Commands run through menagerie.crawler.tools.gate_runner with {python} and {junit} substituted; env is literal. Edits to this file are reviewed schema changes. Every pytest-run gate bounds each test: pytest-timeout (signal method) fails a Python-level hang named and lets the run continue, and the faulthandler exit backstop (a later, process-terminating deadline) names a native-level hang and ends the process; a hung test therefore fails fast and named instead of wedging the gate for hours (fast-tier wedge of 2026-09-02).

collection.description: Collection gate: every corpus module collects with zero errors and at least one test; per-module counts are reported. Replaces the exact-inventory floor. Always re-run (it is the cheapest gate and the one a conflict marker fails).

crawler-smoke.description: Crawler corpus smoke tier (per-push gate), execution floor armed, rigs excluded.

crawler-full.description: Crawler corpus full tier (minus rare, minus rigs): runs when the crawler closure moved.

crawler-rigs.description: The scheduler and shard-merge rigs (the corpus giants over 99 s): run when THEIR inputs move.

tree-hygiene.description: Whole-source-tree hygiene rig (detect-secrets scan, fabricated-lock and runtime-artifact tripwires). Its input is the tracked source tree, so it moves with any source change; docs-only commits are covered by the detect-secrets pre-commit hook instead.

fast-tier.description: TorchLens core fast tier (not rare, not slow, not heavy): runs when torchlens or the non-crawler menagerie moved.
command: not rare and not slow and not heavy

tooling.description: Repository tooling tests (mypy ratchet, merge train, path-overlap preflight): run when tools/ moved.

round21-macos-attestation.description: Round 21 macOS committed-lock release proof: recorded from the release attestation JSON the conftest mints under MENAGERIE_RELEASE_GATE=1 on an Apple-Silicon host with the prefix materialized from the committed lock. Runs when the locks or the registry inputs moved.
